title: Law to require safety checks and shut-off switch for AI models
summary: This bill would make it illegal to market, sell or deploy an artificial intelligence model in New York City unless it has been validated by an independent third party and includes a technical capability allowing a human operator to shut it down. Validators would need to assess factors like accuracy, bias, data privacy and safety, and disclose their findings and any conflicts of interest to the model's developer and the City's Cyber Command office. Violations could bring civil penalties of up to $25,000 per instance, and the law would take effect 180 days after passage.
